heading: Production schedule
subtitle: Direct jobs and project work, together by machine.
refreshFailed: Refresh failed: the last loaded data remains visible.
fleetUnavailable: Machine list unavailable. Jobs can still be viewed and edited.
dragHelp: Drag jobs onto machines in 5-minute steps. Job details allow minute precision.
readOnly: Read only: only administrators can change the schedule.
localTime: Browser-local times. Estimated duration covers the whole job, including all pieces.
reserveHelp: Complete the machine, start time or duration.
noMachines: Add a machine to schedule jobs. You can already create unscheduled jobs.
durationRequired: Set the total job duration in its details before moving it.
noAutomaticFinish: Telemetry does not close this job. Confirm the outcome and end time after checking.
overrun: Elapsed duration exceeds the plan. Other jobs stay in their slots until you confirm a replanning proposal.
metadataOnly: This action records FabCore tracking data. It does not start or stop the machine.
observedMatch: The server will verify this machine is printing or pausing this exact file. The actual start remains unknown unless you enter it.
manualDeclaration: Manual declaration: you confirm this execution without telemetry evidence.
unknownStart: Leave blank if the start time is unknown. Linking never infers a start time.
confirmLinkTarget: I confirm linking job “{title}” to {machine}, file “{file}”.
confirmFinishTarget: I confirm the outcome of “{title}” on {machine}, file “{file}”, and the entered times.
invalidLocalTime: Invalid local date or time; also check daylight-saving changes.
executionError: Operation failed. Refresh and check the current state before retrying.
replanConfirmHelp: Review every shift. Only the confirmation below changes these slots; no machine command will be sent.

observations.different-job: A different file is observed: check this association

errors.execution-invalid: Check the file and declared times. The end cannot precede the start or be in the future.
errors.execution-machine: Assign an available machine before linking an execution.
errors.execution-unavailable: The machine does not report this file as printing or paused. Refresh and check the association.
errors.execution-state: This execution state has changed. Return to the job details before retrying.
errors.execution-busy: An execution is already active on this job or machine.
errors.execution-limit: This job has reached its execution limit.
errors.execution-active: Finish the active execution before changing its machine, slot, duration or state.
errors.replan-unavailable: This proposal requires a confirmed actual end and known planned baseline with an overrun.
errors.replan-expired: The proposal expired. Request a new preview.
errors.project-conflict: Data changed. Your input is kept: return to the details and reopen the action to use the latest revision.
errors.storage-unavailable: Saving failed. Refresh and check the state before retrying.
errors.internal: Operation failed. Refresh and check the state before retrying.
